Package Models.BehaviourStrategies

Class HumanStrategyTest

  • java.lang.Object
    • Models.BehaviourStrategies.HumanStrategyTest
  • @TestInstance(PER_CLASS)
public class HumanStrategyTest
extends java.lang.Object
    Unit tests for the HumanStrategy class, which represents the human behavior strategy for a player in the game. The tests cover the execution of deploy, advance, bomb, blockade, airlift, and diplomacy orders based on the specific strategy rules.
